notifications.title: Notifications & announcements
notifications.description:
Optional. Nothing is sent until you turn it on here.

Placeholders you can use in the messages: {placeholders}

Send a notification: turn on "Enable notifications", pick the notify service of the device you want to reach (your phone, Telegram, e-mail), and choose whether every entry is reported or only certain names. A name listed under "Names to watch" gets its own title and message.

Speak it aloud: turn on "Enable announcements", pick a text-to-speech engine and the speaker (a Google Nest, for example), and type what it should say.
